author: (J.V.Lamouroux) Penrose & Y.M.Chamberlain, 1993

note.en: A thin pink chalky crust that grows on seaweeds and seagrass, recorded at Portete and Puerto Limón on herbarium specimens.
note.es: Una costra rosada y calcárea y delgada que crece sobre algas y pasto marino, registrada en Portete y Puerto Limón en ejemplares de herbario.

evidence: GBIF herbarium specimens: Portete, Puerto Limón and south of the Río Cieneguita (1930 to 1932)

sources.t: GBIF herbarium specimen records inside the region box (Gandoca to Limón)

recWhy: Herbarium specimens from Portete and Puerto Limón only.
